dimensions.justification: All six Must requirements are mapped: REQ-001 to REQ-004 and REQ-008 on SCR-002, REQ-002, REQ-003 and REQ-008 on SCR-001, REQ-005 on SCR-003, and Should requirement REQ-006 on SCR-003.
SCR-001, SCR-002 and SCR-003 each have all ten states with non-empty content, and the index links to every one.

SCR-002 shows the original text beside the draft, a low-confidence warning, direct edit, reject, parse again that keeps the earlier draft, an explanation and a route to manual parsing; confidence is only a High or Low label because the PRD sets no threshold, and the explanation is static example text.

Inputs have labels, buttons and links have text, tables have captions and headers, and the tokens set a 44px target, but colour contrast, focus order and screen reader behaviour of the state sections (SCR-001, SCR-002, SCR-003) were not checked in a rendered page.
Every screen (SCR-001, SCR-002, SCR-003) and the index use the exact token block and only var(--...) for colour, spacing and radius.

Plain copy drawn from the PRD with next steps in the error and empty states of SCR-001 and SCR-002, but the success states of SCR-003 and the 'Message the Engineer Lead' action describe flows the PRD does not fully specify.
